faq.q: What is a titanium slit-valve oval bezel?
faq.a: A titanium slit-valve oval bezel is a precision-machined chamber hardware component used in oval slit-valve sealing bezel for wafer transfer. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium slit-valve oval bezel?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium slit-valve oval bezel manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Slit-Valve Oval Bezel is manufactured using Precision CNC turning. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium slit-valve oval bezel?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
